Yeah... sometimes I think if I hurt myself badly enough, maybe she’d finally notice. Maybe then she’d realize how much I’m suffering. But even that feels pointless now. I don’t know how else to make her care.

I don't know what to do anymore. My best friend is in so much pain, and I feel completely helpless. They keep saying they can't go on like this, and I'm terrified for them. I just want to help, but nothing I say or do seems to make a difference. I feel like I'm failing them.

It's like no matter how much I try to be there for them, it's never enough. They've been withdrawing more and more, and I keep replaying conversations in my head, wondering if I said the wrong thing or missed some sign. I feel like if something happens to them, it'll be my fault for not doing more.

I just don't know what to do anymore. Everything feels so heavy, like I'm drowning and there's no way out. I keep thinking about all the mistakes I've made, and it's just... too much. I don't even know why I'm here, but I guess I just needed someone to talk to before I give up completely.

It's like no matter how hard I try, nothing changes. I feel like I've exhausted all my options, and this is my last attempt to make sense of it all. The pain just doesn't go away, and I'm so tired of fighting it. I don't even know what I'm hoping for anymore.

I guess... I just don't see the point anymore. But then I think about my family, my friends—how much they mean to me. I don't want to hurt them, but I also don't know how to keep going like this. It's like I'm stuck between wanting to be here for them and feeling like I can't take another step.

I just don't see the point anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and I can't stop thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. I've been feeling like this for so long, and no one seems to understand. I don't know what to do.

It's like... ever since my parents divorced, everything just fell apart. I feel like no one really gets how much it messed me up. I hope to get rid of this feeling of depression and regain my passion for life. I also hope to improve communication with family and friends so that they can understand how I feel.

OK, I'll give it a try. But I don't think they might understand my needs and might even blame me.
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you for your encouragement and support.

I remember when I was a child, I always couldn’t meet my parents’ expectations of me. They always criticized me and I felt like I was a failure.
OK, I'll give it a try.

I don’t know... maybe just talking to someone who doesn’t judge me. But it’s hard to believe anyone could care when I can’t even care about myself. I used to have dreams, but now it’s like I’m just waiting for the day to be over. How do you keep going when it feels like the world doesn’t want you here?

I don't even know where to start... Everything feels like it's falling apart. I'm so scared and overwhelmed, like I'm drowning in my own thoughts. I keep making mistakes, and the guilt is eating me alive. I just want it all to stop, but I don't know how.

It's like... no matter what I do, I always end up feeling like a failure. I think about how my parents used to tell me I'd never amount to anything, or how kids at school would laugh at me for being 'weird.' I tried so hard to prove them wrong, but now I just feel broken. Even the ways I used to cope—like hurting myself—don’t work anymore.

I just... I don't know who I am anymore. I used to love drawing—it was the one thing that made me feel alive. But now, even picking up a pencil feels pointless. What if I'm always going to feel this empty? What if nothing ever changes?

I don't even know why I'm here. Everything just feels so overwhelming, like I'm drowning in my own thoughts. Sometimes the only thing that makes sense is the idea of hurting myself—it's like a pressure valve, you know? But then I get scared because I don't actually want to die, I just... I don't know what else to do.

It's like... everything gets too loud inside my head. I'll be sitting there, and suddenly it's like all my failures and mistakes are screaming at me. I feel so small, like nothing I do matters. The pain—physical pain—it's something I can control when everything else feels chaotic. But afterward, I just feel ashamed.

I guess... I wish someone could see how hard I'm trying, even when it doesn't look like it. I'm so scared of being judged as weak or attention-seeking. But the truth is, I just want the pain to stop. I don't know how to ask for help without feeling like a burden.

I just feel so lost and hopeless right now. Like nothing makes sense anymore, and I can't see a way out of this darkness. I keep thinking about ending it all—it's like the only thing that feels like an escape. I don't even know why I'm here or what the point of any of this is.

It's like no one really wants me around. My family... they don't understand me, and I don't think they even try. I've hurt myself before, and sometimes it feels like the only thing that makes the numbness go away. The antidepressants just make me feel blanketed, like I'm not really here. I tried to end things once, and part of me wonders if I should've just succeeded.

I don't know what happens after we die, and that terrifies me too. What if it's just... nothing? Or what if I'm stuck in some kind of limbo? Sometimes I wonder if there's any meaning to life at all, or if I'm just here to suffer. I don't feel like I have any worth, like I'm just a burden to everyone.

Teacher, I am 24 years old and my ex-girlfriend is 19 years old. We met last year and have been talking for almost a year. I went to her house to pay a visit to her family on May 1st this year. She was pregnant when I went there. She was the only daughter at home and I was the only son. I saw that her family was in poor condition and that their family had asked me for a higher bride price, so I was a little hesitant. After we came back, we started arguing about something small, and she proposed to break up, and I agreed. In fact, the reason why we broke up was because I was not considerate enough, not because of her poor family conditions. But I also thought of breaking up because I despised her family conditions. And I had not accompanied her to deal with the aftermath at that time, but she went home and had an abortion. At that time, I didn't realize that it was wrong for me to do this. I slowly reflected on my mistakes a month after the incident. I tried to contact her and transferred a sum of money to subsidize her, hoping to save our relationship, but I knew in my heart that there was no hope. After staying at home for a month, I changed into a new work environment. I thought things would pass slowly, but I still can't forget her until now. I think of her almost every day and occasionally dream about her. I also tried to have a new girlfriend, but I was always impatient with my new girlfriend and was unwilling to communicate. I often go blankly alone now and have no interest in anything. I have tried hard to participate in social activities. Even when I participate in social activities, I will think of her and cannot turn my attention to new things. During this period, I have been working overtime and have not had a rest for a month. I am also half-hearted at work. Sometimes I will try my best to think about her shortcomings and want to use this to hate her, but I still can't forget it. She has now had a new boyfriend, and I know in my heart that we can't go back, so I can only choose to forget, but I can always think of her inadvertently. If I hurt others accidentally, I might forget them. But I think that I hurt others intentionally, I feel very guilty and can't let go. Life is very painful. I want to get rid of this pain.

I can still contact her now, but it is impossible to make up. She has made a new boyfriend. Will I live in the shadows all my life like a runaway murderer? I want to let go of this matter and I will treat others well in the future, but I don’t want to think of this matter all the time. I live so hard!

I tried to save her, and now I believe she won't look back. I feel that my personality has certain flaws. I'm very stingy, too paranoid, and have low emotional intelligence. Even if she looks back, I may still do things that hurt her in the future. Besides, she has a new life now. My life is very depressing now and I think of this every day.

Teacher, you are right! I should face the reality. Although we cannot have emotional connections, if she has any difficulties, I can help her, so that I will let go of this burden and gradually get out of this painful state of mind.

Today I received your guidance and help from the teacher, which made me understand a lot of truths. People cannot always think about their own gains and losses. If they can always consider other people's feelings and feelings when doing things, they will inevitably have a happy mood.

Hello, I think I've been sad lately because I've tried to fix my relationship with my good friend but have been failing. This reminds me of some unpleasant experiences when I was a child. I always feel that I am not good enough to be recognized by others.

We were good friends in college, but after graduation, she refused my communication attempt several times. I felt very hurt because I always regarded her as a very important person. I wonder where I did it wrong.
Yes, I wonder why I feel so helpless and frustrated. I'm afraid I can't handle relationships well, and I'm worried that others will think I'm not good enough.
I expect a warm and harmonious relationship where we can support, understand and care for each other. In this relationship, I feel that I'm worthy of being loved.
Yes, I've been trying to be the best. But I still feel that when I encounter relationship problems and failures, I become very vulnerable.
I know I should be better with myself, but I find it difficult to do it.
Well, I think this point makes sense. But I'm still worried, if I can't do the best, what will others think of me?
I want to give it a try, but I don't know where to start.

turns.message: I just feel so... heavy. Like every breath takes effort. I keep thinking about hurting myself, or worse—just ending it all. It’s like there’s this constant pressure in my chest, and I don’t know how to make it stop. I’m so tired of feeling this way.

It’s everything... my parents are always fighting, and I’m scared they’ll divorce. At school, I feel invisible—like no one would even notice if I disappeared. The only person who checks on me is my friend Jamie, but even then, I feel like a burden. I hate how I look, how I feel... like I’m just... broken.

Jamie’s... kind. They don’t push me to talk, but they stay. I guess that’s something. But what if they leave too? What if my parents split up and I've to move schools again? I don’t think I can start over. Sometimes I just want the pain to stop, no matter what it takes.

I just feel so... heavy. Like every breath takes effort, and nothing matters. I keep thinking about how much easier it would be if I just stopped existing. Not in a dramatic way, just... quietly fading away. It’s like I’m carrying this weight that never lifts, and I don’t even know why I’m still trying.

It’s like... I don’t see the point in anything. Work, relationships, even hobbies—it all feels empty. I used to have goals, things I cared about, but now it’s like I’m just going through the motions. And when I look back, I wonder if I ever really had a purpose or if I was just fooling myself. Maybe this is just how life is for me—always ending up here, lost and numb.

I guess... when I cared, it felt like there was a thread connecting me to something bigger. Like my writing, or helping friends through hard times. But now it’s like the thread snapped, and I’m just... untethered. And yeah, maybe it’s a pattern. I’ve felt this before, but never this deep. Part of me is scared that thread won’t come back this time.

I just feel so exhausted and overwhelmed right now. One minute I was fine, and the next, everything feels heavy and pointless. I keep thinking about hurting myself just to make the pain stop, but I don’t even know why I feel this way. It’s like I can’t control my own emotions anymore.

I don’t know if I should even bring this up with my doctor. Last time I mentioned struggling, they just suggested medication, but I’m scared it’ll numb me out or make things worse. What if this isn’t even depression? What if it’s just... life being life? I don’t want to rely on pills if I don’t have to.

I just want to feel stable, you know? Like I’m not constantly waiting for the next crash. But then I wonder—is this normal? Does everyone feel this way and just deal with it better? I don’t want to pathologize my life, but I also don’t want to ignore something that could be helped.

I don’t even know how to start... I feel so ashamed. Last night, I hurt myself again, and I can’t stop thinking about it. It’s like this heavy weight in my chest, like I’m drowning in guilt. I just feel so empty, like I don’t even recognize myself anymore. Part of me knows I need help, but the other part is terrified of admitting it.

I guess... I don’t even know why I do it. It’s like I’m trying to feel something, or maybe punish myself? I’ve been hiding my depression for so long, even from my closest friends. But yesterday, one of them noticed the marks, and the way they looked at me... it was like a mirror showing me how far I’ve fallen. I don’t even trust myself to make good decisions anymore.

I’m scared of lying to my therapist, too. I’ve been downplaying how bad it is because I don’t want to disappoint them... or maybe I’m scared of what it means if I admit I need more help. What if I’m just broken? But part of me still wants to believe I can get better—I just don’t know how to start.

I just feel so... empty. Like I don't matter at all. I keep thinking about hurting myself because it's the only thing that makes me feel something. I know it's wrong, but part of me believes I deserve it. I'm just so tired of feeling worthless.

It's like... I'm split in two. One part of me is screaming that I'm terrified of dying, but the other part just doesn't care. I've been told my whole life that I'm too much or not enough, and now I can't even tell what's real. I don't know how to stop believing I'm broken.

I think... it wants to be held. To know that someone sees me as a person who deserves to take up space. But that feels impossible. How do I even start to believe that when everything in me says I shouldn't exist?

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I am really troubled recently and don’t know how to deal with my marriage.

I married my husband for three years, but I felt that he was less and less concerned about me and the children. He has been working in another place and his income is OK, but in the past year, he has sent less and less money to go home. Even when his child is sick, he also ignores the excuse of not having money.

Yes, I always wished for a warm home, but the reality made me feel very cold. I brought the child to my husband, but the situation did not improve, but it became even more difficult. I was under a lot of pressure and didn't know what to do.
OK, thank you.
Yes, I feel like I'm working hard to maintain this home, but my husband doesn't seem to care about me and the kids. He would even rather go out for a trip with his friends than go home to see us.
Communicate, but he always finds excuses to escape. I feel the gap between us is getting deeper and deeper, and I really don't know what to do.
So what should I do now?
Thank you for your advice, I will try hard. But I'm still worried, what should I do if my husband is unwilling to change?
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you, psychological counselor, you gave me a lot of inspiration.
Hello, psychological counselor, I am in a very low mood recently and don’t know how to face my life.
I have been married for many years, but recently I found out that I don’t have a deep relationship with my husband and I have always missed my first love boyfriend.
Yes, I feel very conflicted. On the one hand, I know I shouldn't be like this, but on the other hand, I can't let go of my feelings for my first love boyfriend.
I want to give it a try, but I don't know how to get started.
My childhood was quite happy, but I always felt that my parents didn’t care enough for me, and I was always looking for the feeling of being cared for by others.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home, to live a plain and happy life with my husband and children.
I think my husband doesn't care enough about me. He is always busy with work and rarely stays with me and my children.
OK, I will try hard. But I was still worried that it would be too difficult for me to let go of my first love boyfriend.
Thank you, psychological counselor. I will actively cooperate with the consultation and hope we can solve the problem together.
Hello, psychological counselor, I recently discovered that my husband had an ambiguous chat with a opposite sex, which made me very confused and painful. I don't know how to deal with this.

I think I was hurt because I always thought our marriage was harmonious. Now I don't know how to face my husband, and I'm worried that he will cheat again. I tried to forgive him, but I could never overcome this hurdle.

turns.message: I just got off the phone with my parents, and I feel like I can't breathe. My chest is so tight, and my hands won't stop shaking. Everything feels like it's crashing down around me, and I don't know how to make it stop. I just want to disappear.

I don't even know why I feel this way. It's like no matter what I do, it's never enough. I'm so tired of trying and failing. Sometimes I just wish I could stop existing so I wouldn't have to feel this pain anymore.
I have to see my parents soon, and I’m terrified. I feel so small and vulnerable, like a child again. I don’t know how to face them without crumbling. What if they see how broken I am?

I just can't take it anymore. Every day feels like a weight pressing down on me, and I don't see the point in going on. My wife left, and it's like she took everything good with her. The pain is constant, and I don't know how to make it stop. I just want it all to end.

It's like I was nothing to her—just someone to use until she didn't need me anymore. I gave everything to our family, and now I’m left with nothing. Part of me just wants to let go, but then I think about my kids. They’re the only reason I’m still here, but even that feels like a thin thread. I don’t want to hurt them, but I don’t know how much longer I can keep pretending I’m okay.

I just don’t want them to see me like this—broken, useless. Sometimes I think if I could leave in a way that meant something, like sacrificing myself for them, maybe it wouldn’t hurt as much. At least then my life would have purpose. But I know that’s not really true. I just don’t know how to find meaning anymore.

I just don't know what to do anymore. Everything feels like it's falling apart. My parents are fighting all the time, and I can't focus at school. I feel like I'm drowning, and no matter how hard I try, I can't keep up. I just want to disappear sometimes.

It's like... no matter what I do, it's never enough. I try to stay out of the way at home, but the fighting still gets to me. And at school, I just zone out. Sometimes I hurt myself because it's the only thing that makes me feel something, you know? Like I'm still here. But then I just feel worse afterward.

I don't know... it's like this emptiness, like I'm not even a person anymore. Like nothing matters. But then afterward, I just feel guilty and stupid. I don't want to keep doing this, but I don't know how to stop. I don't even know if things can get better.

I just feel so heavy all the time, like I can't breathe. The thoughts keep coming—what if I just... disappeared? It’s like my mind won’t let me rest. I’ve tried to stop the pain in small ways, but it never feels like enough. I don’t know how to make it stop.

It’s like... no one really sees me. At work, I’m just a problem to fix, and at home, my parents act like I’m some mistake they have to deal with. I try so hard to be what people need, but it’s never enough. Maybe they’d all be better off if I wasn’t here. I don’t want to hurt them, but I don’t know how to keep existing like this.

I don’t even know who I am outside of that anymore. Sometimes I catch myself wanting... more. Like there’s a tiny voice saying, 'What if things could be different?' But then the guilt crushes me. How can I want to live when everything hurts so much? How do I matter if the world keeps showing me I don’t?

I just hate myself so much right now. Everything feels pointless, and I'm so angry—at myself, at the world. I can't stop thinking about how worthless I am. It's like there's this heavy, dark cloud pressing down on me, and I don't know how to make it go away.

I don't even know where it all comes from. Sometimes I look in the mirror and feel disgusted, like I don't deserve to take up space. And then there's this person in my life—I hate them, but I also hate that I can't just let it go. It's like their voice is stuck in my head, telling me I'll never be enough.

I don't know if I can even imagine it. It's like... I've been stuck in this cycle for so long that hope feels dangerous. What if I try to believe in myself and just fail again? The idea of being kind to myself almost feels like a lie.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I recently found that there are some problems with my marriage, and I would like to ask you to analyze it for me.

Hello, that's right, I found that my husband no longer pampers me as much as before recently, and after we had a fight, he no longer coaxed me. I suspect he has a lover outside, but I can't find any evidence.

Half a year ago, he had a business to negotiate, but I was in a bad mood that day and insisted that he came back to accompany me. He told me that I couldn't come back, so I cried and made a fuss, and kept calling him. Since then, he has gradually stopped coaxing me.
We had a good relationship before, he loved me very much, and I was used to being pampered by him. But this time, I feel like our relationship is out of balance.
I hope he can care more about me and my children and be by our side.
He never seemed to have made it clear, but I could feel that he was under pressure, but he was not willing to say it.
OK, I'd like to give it a try. But I don't know how to start.
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you for your suggestions!
Thank you for your encouragement, I will try to change. I hope our marriage can regain harmony.
OK, goodbye! I wish you a smooth work!
Hello, psychological counselor, I've encountered some marriage problems recently and would like to ask you for advice.
Thanks. My husband and I are a friend, but he actually had an affair. I once negotiated with the mistress, but she never admitted it. what do I do?
I feel helpless and don't know what to do. We get along well in normal times, but when we mention this issue, he avoids talking about it. I really don't know what to do.
I think about it... Actually, he has always disliked me interfering in his life too much. I always want to ask him for his goals, but he doesn't seem happy.
(Silence for a while) OK, I will try to write it down.
Hello, psychological counselor, I've encountered some marriage problems recently and would like to ask you for advice.

Thanks. My husband and I got the marriage certificate, but we haven't held the wedding yet. We used to get along well, but after getting married, he became very concerned about money, which made me feel very uncomfortable.
He always cares about our living expenses now, and even I've to buy a bowl of fried noodles. And he is very generous with his family affairs, but he is very stingy with my family.

Because he cared too much about money, we often quarreled. I think he doesn't care enough about me, and sometimes he even wants to get a divorce, but he is worried about his future life. I'm not young anymore and don't know what to do.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home where couples care and support each other. Of course, the economic foundation is also important, but it should not be the whole of life.
